name: flowsight-ai
description: FlowSight AI - Privacy-first developer activity monitor with local AI

scripts.build:mac:arm: FLOWSIGHT_LLM_ARCH=macos-arm64 bash scripts/prepare-macos-llm.sh && corepack pnpm --filter @flowsight/agent exec tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:mac:intel: FLOWSIGHT_LLM_ARCH=macos-x64 FLOWSIGHT_SKIP_LLM_RUN=1 bash scripts/prepare-macos-llm.sh && rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin && corepack pnpm --filter @flowsight/agent exec tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin
